create_EarlyStopping: create an EarlyStopping instance with a model, checkpoint, criteria, and patience threshold
call_EarlyStopping: call the EarlyStopping instance with update, iteration, and meter to check if training should stop
check_EarlyStopping_is_activated: check whether the EarlyStopping mechanism has been activated by calling is_activated method
init_EarlyStopping_from_checkpoint: initialize EarlyStopping state from a checkpoint load dictionary with best iteration and metric value
get_EarlyStopping_info: get a summary dictionary of the best update, iteration, and monitored metric value from EarlyStopping
